core_obligations: Start from an arbitrary short exact sequence and use flatness of M to keep it exact after tensoring over R with M (proof lines 1555-1560).
Apply faithfulness of C to get a short exact sequence of the C's of the tensor products (proof lines 1561-1565).
Rewrite that sequence by the adjunction identity as the Hom sequence out of the original terms into C(M), which is the injectivity statement (proof lines 1565-1570).
difficulty_reason: For a flat module M over a ring R, the lemma shows that its image under the functor C is an injective R-module (statement lines 1549-1552). The proof tests injectivity against an arbitrary short exact sequence: flatness makes the tensor product of that sequence with M exact, faithfulness of C carries exactness over to the sequence of C applied to those tensor products, and the adjunction identity rewrites that sequence as the Hom sequence out of the original terms into C(M) (proof lines 1554-1569). Exactness of that Hom sequence is precisely injectivity of C(M). The claim is H2: three one-step rewrites, but the successive use of flatness, faithfulness and the adjunction is the whole content and is written out in display form.
